name: exec-out-of-memory
about: A command the kernel killed because the sandbox ran out of memory: the answer says so, with a code and a fix. execd tells the node from inside the sandbox; on an older execd the answer is the bare exit status.

response.error: the command was stopped because the sandbox ran out of memory (1 GiB)
response.fix: run less at once, or use a larger sandbox
